title: Scripted Localisation
intro: defined_text dynamic loc-key dispatch blocks (common/scripted_localisation/). Referenced from other strings as [GetX]. Internal HOI4 symbols, not player-facing text.
emptyAll: No scripted localisation blocks yet. Create a dynamic loc-key dispatch block here.
selectHint: Select a scripted localisation block, or create a new one.
nameHint: The symbol other loc strings call as [Name]. Must be unique within this project.
sourceFileHint: Mod-relative path this block exports to. Leave blank for an auto-named file.
bodyHint: The whole inner content, including the name line and every text entry. It round-trips verbatim: on export it's wrapped back into defined_text automatically.
emptyHeroDesc: Dynamic defined_text blocks, referenced in strings as [GetX]. Create your first one to get started.
